summary: Renames formatPrice to formatMoney and adds a currency parameter that uses Intl.NumberFormat. invoiceLines now takes a currency with a USD default.

findings.title: Removed formatPrice export still imported by cart
findings.problem: This change renames formatPrice to formatMoney in src/money.ts. src/cart.ts still imports formatPrice and calls it at line 8.
findings.consequence: The TypeScript build fails, so cartTotal cannot ship. Under plain ES modules, loading cart.ts throws a missing export error.
findings.fix: Update src/cart.ts to import formatMoney and call formatMoney(addTax(subtotal, taxRate), "USD"). Alternatively, keep formatPrice as a wrapper that delegates to formatMoney.

findings.title: Changed money formatting has no covering test
findings.problem: formatMoney now uses Intl.NumberFormat, which adds thousands separators and supports other currencies. The repository has no test that checks this output.
findings.consequence: Format regressions in invoice and cart strings go unnoticed. Invalid currency codes, which make Intl.NumberFormat throw, also go unnoticed.
findings.fix: Add tests for formatMoney and invoiceLines. Cover large amounts, a non-USD currency and an invalid currency code.
